posts.name: Pydro
posts.cooked: No glitch. With Sub-zero atmosphere, all end actions happen at start. Omni plays a card at the end, which is actually the start. Since it is still the start, EPE goes off immediately. Not always a good idea to play Sub-Zero against Omni.

posts.name: Killswitch
posts.cooked:
That's not what Sub-Zero Atmosphere says, though. It says nothing about start of turn effects happening at the end, just the inverse. Unless it was ruled somewhere where the inverse is also true.

Any Villain card which would act at the end of the Villain turn instead acts at the start of the Villain turn.

Sounds like a glitch to me.
